desc: The T3x Roughtech Ranch has a blued-fluted medium contour barrel, a barrel length of 16” or 20”, and a muzzle thread in 5/8-24. Dotted with a Picatinny rail on the receiver, you can easily mount any optics. Its Roughtech Black stock fits with the portfolio of T3x rifle series accessories. It is offered in 223 Rem, 308 Win, and 350 Legend.
